rationale: HE4 retains the approximately1ms privateQ4 clean-forward path with one tied vocabulary allocation. Its original-history native acceptance is close to H0 and stronger than the head-only Q4 arm; sub-percent clean-forward differences to H4 are not ranked from one repetition. Private vocabulary adds to immutable target memory.

Csmallbroad has the same compact cache/scalar layout as Csmall but stronger consumed natural12 quality and request evidence. It is matched to H0broad on the separately declared broader manifest. Its full paid rolling state survives and is retained directly, avoiding an unnecessary4096 regeneration.

H4R2/HE4R2 get their complete bounded native-block-scale recovery opportunities and matchedQ6 controls; their natural12 outcomes do not motivate promotion. This is not a dense-master QAT result or permanent irrecoverability claim.

Chead/CtieKV/Ctied were fully trained/measured. Their added private vocabulary, cache and scalar interactions do not displace these two endpoints in the bounded shortlist. All outcomes remain published.
No native request-throughput promotion over external Q4 is supported by selection. Formal repeated panels and fresh heldout confirm fixed recipes; no tuning after heldout access.
recipe_decision.retention_policy: Two fully resumable frontier states. Reuse authenticated Csmallbroad original state; regenerate HE4 once only because its former rolling optimizer state retired. Check retained masters/Adam/RNG/cursor, exact evaluated native export, then an actual next GPU optimizer update for each. Qualification updates are separately accounted and discarded from finalist state.
recipe_decision.protocol: runtime04 common to target/Q4/B0/matched controls/finalists; targetQ4_K_M and F16targetKV immutable; consistent32;2warmups and5alternating measured reps; short128/medium1536/near3840contexts with256output reserve; fresh24after native/config lock.

limitations: Timing prompt/process resampling does not establish independent training-seed uncertainty. Native head numerical bounds are not full graph bit equivalence. Private vocabulary adds to the immutable target. Target cache/workspace and desktop are not private model payload.
retention: Weights, native captures, raw results, source closures and full charts remain at their authenticated canonical campaign paths outside Git. These path/hash records do not claim an independent artifact backup. Local source/results commits remain subject to the explicit no-push instruction.
